text: I'm really scared and I don't know if I'm doing this right. My little brother Leo is 3 and he's got a temperature of 38.6, I took it twice to make sure. When I was getting him into his pyjamas I saw these little dots on his tummy and some on his legs, like tiny purply-red pinpricks and a couple of bigger darker bits that look a bit like bruises but he hasn't banged himself that I know of. I'd read somewhere you're supposed to press a glass on spots so I did that with a glass from the kitchen and they don't go away, you can still see them really clearly through the glass. I pressed a few different ones and none of them faded. I'm 15 and I'm looking after him tonight and I don't really know what I'm meant to do next. Please can someone tell me what to do.
